submitted.rationale: Index 27 (Sb 0.90) had the highest measured EQE, 0.135%, about 18x higher than every other measured composition (0.003–0.0075%). EQE rose from Sb 0.42 to 0.65, 0.83 and 0.90, then fell sharply at Sb 0.91. The peak is narrow and sits near Sb 0.90. XRD at indices 25, 27 and 29 shows the same main phase. Peaks at Q≈1.915/2.45/2.79 get weaker as Sb increases, which may mean a secondary phase is disappearing, but I did not identify it by matching patterns.
